degree_rationale: Why cutting nails/hairs doesn't pain the man, but cutting a member does — body likened to land, members to trees: some grow back when cut, others don't. Treats the natural-bodily completion of which parts regenerate and which suffer permanent loss.
direction_rationale: The settled completion of which body-parts can be lost without pain — the outermost peripheries vs. the rooted limbs. West = the settled distinction of completed bodily composition.
grand_man_function: Natural extremity-completion — the settled distinction of regenerative vs. essential parts.
title: Why pruning rather than illness affects the elements
